clips.title: The story
paras: Inside Gadgetzan's inn, Dirge Quikcleave holds court as a goblin culinary master and vendor. His inventive dishes are renowned across Azeroth, and seasoned chefs come to him to master artisan cooking.

In dusty Gadgetzan, Dirge Quikcleave serves drinks and meat to travelers parched by the Tanaris sands. Though his kitchen is in a frontier tavern, he claims to be Azeroth's greatest living culinary artist. Cooking trainers in cities send their most promising students to him when ordinary lessons are spent. Dirge's demanding recipes call for unusual ingredients, from giant clam meat and eggs for his Clamlette creations to exotic beasts from distant shores.

Dirge Quikcleave pairs a gourmand's bravado with a goblin's eye for business. Across Kalimdor, he keeps contacts with eccentric figures and seeks out dangerous culinary ventures. Those who bring him fierce beast cuts, such as meat from the monstrous chimaeroks of Feralas's Isle of Dread, can receive hearty recipes fit to sustain champions on perilous journeys. They must not ask too many questions about Dirge's private dealings.

related.n: Never Ask Me About My Business
